lang.name: English
lang.label: Language
banner.title: This is an AI tool.
banner.body: It looks at faces in photos and suggests possible matches. Suggestions can be wrong. A person checks every match before you see it.
footer.free: Free to use. No account is needed to appeal, report misuse or ask for help.
index.title: Add a photo
index.lead: We find the faces in your photo so you can search for them later. A reviewer checks each photo before it can be searched. We remove location and camera details and the file name.
index.techBody: Faces are detected with InsightFace (and Amazon Rekognition if configured). Each face becomes a list of 512 numbers (a face embedding) stored in Qdrant.
index.scope: Only for photos you are allowed to use, of people who agreed. Not for watching or identifying strangers.
index.signin: Sign in with an operator key to add photos.
consent.index: Everyone who can be recognised in this photo agreed to have their face analysed and indexed, and I am allowed to upload it.
consent.search: The person in this photo agreed to this search (or I am that person). I understand results are only suggestions until a reviewer checks them.
minors.question: Does this photo show anyone under 18?
minors.guardian: A parent or guardian of each child agreed. (Photos of children are always checked by a person and deleted sooner.)
search.title: Find photos of a person
search.lead: Choose a clear photo of one face. The system suggests photos that look similar. A reviewer checks each suggestion before you see it. A suggestion is not proof of who someone is.
search.techBody: The largest face is turned into a face embedding and compared with approved faces using cosine similarity. Only scores at or above the governed minimum are suggested.
search.purpose.consenting: To find photos of a person who agreed to this search
search.human: Prefer a person to do this instead? Ask for help
search.signin: Sign in with an operator key to search.
drop.label: Choose or drop a photo
drop.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB. Large photos are made smaller on your device before upload.
drop.aria: Choose a photo to upload. Press Enter or Space to open the file picker.
a11y.title: Accessibility & help
a11y.lead: We want everyone to be able to use this service, appeal a result, or ask for help.
support.title: Ask for help
support.lead: Tell us what you need. A person will reply in the way you choose. You do not need an account.
support.topic.human_assistance: A person to do this for me instead of the AI
support.topic.accessibility: Help using the site (screen reader, keyboard, vision, hearing)
support.topic.cost: I cannot pay for internet or a device
support.sent: Sent. Your reference is {id}. Keep it with this access token: {token}
